description: This PHP source file defines the Data Access Object (DAO) class 'ScreenPermissionDao' within the 'OrangeHRM' project. The class provides a method to retrieve screen permissions based on a module, action URL, and user roles, interacting with the database using Doctrine QueryBuilder.

classes.name: ScreenPermissionDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for fetching screen permission records from the database based on module, action URL, and user roles.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ScreenPermission entities filtered by module name, action URL, and provided user roles (either as UserRole objects or role name strings).
